title: Open Logic Project — Edisi Lengkap Bahasa Indonesia / Complete Indonesian Edition (OLP-0722, 722/722)
description:
Edisi lengkap Bahasa Indonesia / Complete Indonesian edition: all 722/722 frozen Open Logic Project content modules are translated. The 1,116-page linked reader covers the 642 canonical-reader-reachable modules; 80 retained non-reader modules remain in the editable corpus and are explicitly outside build/render applicability. Frozen authority: commit 9620cc73f9c8e0ad003c514a5d3748f29611c4c0, tree f67757bb9305b173634082ab4cefd5601a707a34, under CC BY 4.0.

All 722 targets passed exact source/hash replay and model-review admission. The reader passed a deterministic build, text-layer checks, and all-page visual inspection. Editable source and evidence packages preserve terminology, translation decisions, source-backed emendations, build/render receipts, hashes, closure records, and hostile-compaction recovery state.

Exact release DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21932787. Stable Indonesian concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21932786. Repository: KokunoYumeto/OpenLogic-id.

Performed at the direction of Floris by OpenAI 5.6 Sol, Ultra mode (OpenAI's current flagship model for complex work). No Open Logic Project endorsement is implied.
